description: Implementation of vertex buffer copying and conversion functions, including templates for copying and converting vertex data between different formats and component counts, with support for packed formats and normalization.

methods.name: CopyNativeVertexData
methods.description: Copies and converts native vertex data between formats, handling component count differences and setting default alpha values.

methods.name: Copy8SintTo16SintVertexData
methods.description: Converts 8-bit signed integer vertex data to 16-bit signed integer format.

methods.name: Copy8SnormTo16SnormVertexData
methods.description: Converts 8-bit signed normalized vertex data to 16-bit signed normalized format.

methods.name: Copy32FixedTo32FVertexData
methods.description: Converts 32-bit fixed-point vertex data to 32-bit float format.

methods.name: CopyTo32FVertexData
methods.description: Converts various typed vertex data to 32-bit float format, with optional normalization.

methods.name: CopyXYZ10W2ToXYZW32FVertexData
methods.description: Converts packed 10/2 bit vertex data to 32-bit float format for XYZW components.

methods.name: CopyXYZ10ToXYZW32FVertexData
methods.description: Converts packed 10-bit RGB vertex data to XYZW float format with default alpha.

methods.name: CopyW2XYZ10ToXYZW32FVertexData
methods.description: Converts packed W2XYZ10 vertex data to XYZW float format.
